prompt: Create a map of Europe in 1914 immediately before the First World War. Show national borders and label the major states, including the German Empire, Austro-Hungarian Empire, Russian Empire, Ottoman Empire, France, United Kingdom, Italy, Serbia, Romania, Bulgaria, Greece, Belgium, and the Netherlands. Distinguish the Triple Entente and Central Powers with a legend.

spec.title: Europe on the Eve of the First World War
spec.subtitle: National Borders and Major Alliances, July 28, 1914

sources.title: American Geographical Society Library: Europe 1914 Map
Library of Congress: World War I Declarations
Canadian War Museum: Origins and Early Phases of WWI

notes: Borders reflect de facto control as of July 28, 1914, the day Austria-Hungary declared war on Serbia.
The Ottoman Empire is shown as neutral, though it joined the Central Powers in October 1914.
Italy, though a member of the Triple Alliance, is shown as neutral; it joined the Entente in 1915.
Disputed territories such as Alsace-Lorraine and Bosnia and Herzegovina are shown under the control of the de facto administering power.
spec.referenceSummary: Based on authoritative historical border datasets and contemporary maps of Europe in 1914.

checks.message: 21 historical regions use bounded, non-executable polygon geometry.
Every mapped region cites a declared web source.
10 web citations grounded the map specification.
Boundaries are schematic. Editorial review against the cited sources is required before publication.
21 filled historical territories were retained. Consider simplifying the map if the overview is visually crowded.
